title: 2026년 10월 11일, 인공지능 분야에서 무슨 일이 일어났을까요?
intro: Context management moved into the model: Meta, MIT and the University of Washington introduced Context Language Models, which edit their own context instead of relying on predefined rules.

Builders also shipped coding-agent tooling and harness write-ups, while DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash reached a hosted inference API and DeepSeek and Huawei were reported shipping six Ascend tools aimed at CUDA.
highlights: Context Language Models let a model manage and edit its own context to cut compute cost.
A Show HN coding agent writes its own multi-agent workflows.
A from-scratch agent harness walkthrough and a file-tree memory for coding agents landed on HN.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is live on the Dolphin inference API.
DeepSeek and Huawei reportedly ship six Ascend tools to rival CUDA.
